## What's New
* Added coin grouping items that can be toggled on via yaml
* Renamed coin item names to something more reasonable based on their group

This is fully backwards compatible with old seeds

## Setup
To install the client mod:
1. Get the Tamper Monkey extension for your browser
2. Install the script from below by clicking it (should install automatically)
3. Navigate to https://www.coolmathgames.com/0-johnny-upgrade
4. Have fun :)
